capabilities: Render authored furigana syntax as ruby
Add automatic ruby annotations colored by JLPT level
Look up Japanese words in offline Japanese-Korean and Japanese-English dictionaries
Add, remove, and cycle furigana via commands
Toggle dictionary, visible, and hidden ruby display modes
extras: Downloads about 60 MB of dictionary and tokenizer data from GitHub Releases on first desktop launch, then works fully offline with no account or API key. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: No separate Advanced Ruby plugin is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in furigana rendering or automatic reading annotations for Japanese text, and existing ruby plugins don't filter by learner level or include dictionaries.

relations.evidence: No separate Advanced Ruby plugin is required.

summary: Furigana plugin that renders authored ruby, adds non-destructive automatic readings colored by JLPT level, and searches offline Japanese dictionaries.
